sections.basis: annual net taxable salary per family share (quotient familial): gross pay less employee pension contributions, less 20%, rounded down to XAF 1,000 and divided by the number of shares; the first band (0 to 615,000) pays a flat XAF 1,200 instead of a rate; the tax per share is multiplied by the number of shares (art. 116 to 116 G CGI)

rows.label: ITS: flat amount on the first band and minimum tax
rows.note: flat tax per family share on the first band of the ITS scale (XAF 0 to 615,000 per share); also the annual minimum where gross pay is below the minimum wage (SMIG).

source.title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo, édition spéciale n° 3-2026 du 5 janvier 2026: Loi n° 42-2025 du 31 décembre 2025 portant loi de finances pour l'année 2026

rows.label: Tax on business profits of individuals (IBA)
rows.note: impôt sur les bénéfices d'affaires (IBA): business profits of individuals taxed on actual profit, rounded down to XAF 1,000; at least the minimum tax of 1.5% of total income.

source.title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo, édition spéciale n° 3-2026 du 5 janvier 2026: Loi n° 42-2025 du 31 décembre 2025 portant loi de finances pour l'année 2026

rows.label: ITS: flat 20% deduction
rows.note: flat deduction from net salary after the employee share of pension contributions, before the family-share calculation.

source.title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo, édition spéciale n° 3-2026 du 5 janvier 2026: Loi n° 42-2025 du 31 décembre 2025 portant loi de finances pour l'année 2026

rows.label: ITS: number of family shares (1 to 6.5)
rows.value: Family shares (quotient familial) for the ITS: single, divorced or widowed without children 1; married without children 2; single or divorced with one child 2; married or widowed with one child 2.5; then half a share more per dependent child, up to 6.5 shares.

source.title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo, édition spéciale n° 3-2026 du 5 janvier 2026: Loi n° 42-2025 du 31 décembre 2025 portant loi de finances pour l'année 2026

rows.label: ITS: exempt income
rows.value: Exempt from the ITS: business expense reimbursements, transport allowances paid to all staff within the collective agreement, severance under a redundancy plan, retirement pensions, family allowances from public bodies, work-accident benefits, state study grants, death capital, end-of-career payments within the collective agreement and unemployment benefits. No other exemption may be granted.

source.title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo, édition spéciale n° 3-2026 du 5 janvier 2026: Loi n° 42-2025 du 31 décembre 2025 portant loi de finances pour l'année 2026

rows.label: ITS: monthly withholding by the employer
rows.value: The ITS is paid by monthly instalments withheld at source by the employer; the withholding is final where the employee has a single source of salary, otherwise an annual salary return is filed. In 2026 the ITS is computed as the IRPP was, under articles 114 to 116 H.

source.title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo, édition spéciale n° 3-2026 du 5 janvier 2026: Loi n° 42-2025 du 31 décembre 2025 portant loi de finances pour l'année 2026

rows.label: Non-residents: ITS on work done in the Congo
rows.value: Salaries are taxable in the Congo when the recipient is domiciled there, or, for a recipient not domiciled in the Congo, when the paid activity is carried out there and the employer is domiciled or established there.

rows.value: Retirement pensions are exempt from the ITS.

rows.note: flat tax on telecommunication pylons in the large towns (Pointe-Noire, Brazzaville, Dolisie, Madingou, Nkayi, Oyo, Owando, Ouesso); XAF 500,000 per pylon elsewhere. Unit: per pylon.

rows.value: Annual road tax (taxe de roulage) plus urban parking fee: mopeds XAF 1,500; scooters and motorcycles XAF 3,000; cars 0 to 5 CV XAF 7,000 + 5,000; 6 to 11 CV 10,000 + 5,000; 12 to 15 CV 13,000 + 5,000; 16 to 20 CV 25,000 + 10,000; 21 to 25 CV 30,000 + 10,000; 26 to 30 CV 60,000 + 10,000; 31 CV and more 90,000 + 10,000. Taxis, taxi-buses, buses and motorcycle taxis are exempt; 10% penalty after 31 March.

rows.value: Tax on polluting activities (from 2026), on quantities produced, imported, extracted or disposed of: plastic packaging XAF 500 per kg; mineral extraction XAF 5,000 per m³; hazardous industrial waste XAF 2,500 per tonne; lubricants, paints, solvents and pesticides XAF 500 per litre.

rows.note: registration duty on deeds of capital increase and extension of companies, on total contributions net of liabilities (1%, 0.5% and 0.1% by tranche for companies under the Investment Charter and agricultural companies).

sections.title: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: Flat-rate regime (IGF) for small businesses
rows.value: Businesses whose turnover does not exceed the VAT registration threshold are taxed under the flat-rate regime (impôt global forfaitaire, IGF), unless they opt for VAT or the real regime; regulated professions, bakers, building contractors, hardware dealers, wholesalers and importers are excluded.

source.title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo, édition spéciale n° 3-2026 du 5 janvier 2026: Loi n° 42-2025 du 31 décembre 2025 portant loi de finances pour l'année 2026

rows.label: Turnover above which the real regime applies
rows.note: annual turnover above which a business is taxed on actual profit (régime du réel) and files with the medium-sized enterprises unit.

source.title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo, édition spéciale n° 3-2026 du 5 janvier 2026: Loi n° 42-2025 du 31 décembre 2025 portant loi de finances pour l'année 2026

rows.label: Flat-rate regime: annual base and quarterly returns
rows.value: Taxpayers under the flat-rate regime keep paraphed registers and declare by the 15th of the month after each quarter; the IGF base is set each year by 15 February from return no. 294 and its financial statements.

source.title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo, édition spéciale n° 3-2026 du 5 janvier 2026: Loi n° 42-2025 du 31 décembre 2025 portant loi de finances pour l'année 2026

rows.label: Withholding on contracts in the Congo–Angola petroleum unitisation zone
rows.note: withholding at source on income of Congolese or foreign individuals and companies from contracts in the petroleum unitisation zone with Angola.

rows.label: IBA withheld at source on partners in transparent companies
rows.value: The IBA due by individuals on their share of profit in a tax-transparent company is withheld at source (art. 183 CGI).

rows.value: Annual road tax (taxe de roulage) plus urban parking fee: mopeds XAF 1,500; scooters and motorcycles XAF 3,000; cars 0 to 5 CV XAF 7,000 + 5,000; 6 to 11 CV 10,000 + 5,000; 12 to 15 CV 13,000 + 5,000; 16 to 20 CV 25,000 + 10,000; 21 to 25 CV 30,000 + 10,000; 26 to 30 CV 60,000 + 10,000; 31 CV and more 90,000 + 10,000. rows.label: Flat-rate regime (IGF) for small businesses
rows.value: Businesses whose turnover does not exceed the VAT registration threshold are taxed under the flat-rate regime (impôt global forfaitaire, IGF), unless they opt for VAT or the real regime; regulated professions, bakers, building contractors, hardware dealers, wholesalers and importers are excluded.

rows.label: Flat-rate regime: annual base and quarterly returns
rows.value: Taxpayers under the flat-rate regime keep paraphed registers and declare by the 15th of the month after each quarter; the IGF base is set each year by 15 February from return no. 294 and its financial statements.
